focused_coverage: Read-only record parameters reserve no unused frame slot; debug builds retain local storage.
Repeated REPL submissions rebind parameter views; direct and returned private mutations preserve saved values.
Native/web default builds inline checked leaf helpers while retaining actual out-of-bounds failure and correct values live across the call.
development_notes: Initial failure-path tests assumed args() excluded argv[0] and that the standalone Node harness forwarded arguments automatically. Corrected test setup to match existing runner conventions; compiler implementation was unchanged for those failures.

notes: All 44 comparisons pass without rechecks. Seven runtime workloads use prior artifact certificates plus fresh correctness checks; managed parameters receive fresh matched timings in both modes and C.
Early binding alone removes the unused frame slot but measured no clear runtime improvement. The combined default inliner change reduces the managed-parameter kernel to 0.596 times previous CPU time.
Release managed parameters remain about 1.559 times C. This stage does not meet broad C parity or the 250k fresh root lines/s goal.
